Event counts by type, severity and status in a time range

get.description: Every bucket of the range in order (empty ones with zero counts); the first bucket starts at `from`, the last ends at `to`. Buckets follow daylight saving time of `tz`: a repeated hour is two buckets, a skipped hour none, a day lasts 23 to 25 hours. Tenancy as `GET /surveillance/stats`.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Bucket size (at most 1000 buckets per request)

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA time zone name of the bucket boundaries (local hours and days, e.g. WIB), any case; the response echoes the database spelling. UTC offsets such as `+07:00` are refused (use `Etc/GMT-7`), and so are names the database does not know (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED`)
